statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and intermittent dizziness
There is clinical suspicion for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation
The symptoms are episodic in nature
There is a need to correlate rhythm disturbances with clinical events
The diagnosis codes are I49.9, I48.0 and R42
The denial reason code is PR-204
The denial is based on the service not being covered under the member's current benefit plan
